pricing.transitDays: Pickup and return days outside selected use dates add no rental charge.
pricing.inventory: The full pickup-to-return period plus preparation and cleaning remains reserved.
pricing.paymentPlanControls: Admin can enable allowed plans; amounts and policy are re-quoted and accepted server-side.
pricing.security: Effective security collection timing follows the plan. Security remains distinct from rent.
pricing.cancellation: Customer requests cancellation; authorized admin records the decision and may retain zero, some or all paid rent. Security and approved deductions remain separate.

preservedSafeguards: Server quote fingerprint and policy revision
Real physical-piece availability and transaction fences
Verified gateway amounts and pending payment recovery
Full agreed payment required before handover
Sale and rental stock, bags and checkout remain separate

includes: Admin payment settings and refund controls

backend.providers: Test fixtures and mocks; production licence enforcement retained
